slots.idleBroker.body.defaultMessage: {names} is Windows' idle Sandbox broker, left by {agent}'s last session in a Combwork that has since closed. No Sandbox is running, so releasing the slot is safe: Release Slot… frees it for other work, and the broker is left running.
slots.idleBroker.body.description: The notice (HI-2309) that a slot stays held only by Windows' idle Windows Sandbox broker after Combwork restarted: Combwork doesn't release it by itself, and asks the user. {names}: the broker's process names (WindowsSandboxServer); {agent}: the agent whose session left it. Release Slot… is the button's name.

slots.idleBroker.release.description: The notice's button (HI-2309): opens the question that frees a slot held only by Windows' idle Sandbox broker.

slots.idleBroker.title.description: A notice's title (HI-2309): a slot (a worktree Combwork lends to a card, {slot} such as slot-a) stays held after Combwork restarted, only by Windows' own idle Windows Sandbox broker ({names}: its process names, such as WindowsSandboxServer).

slots.move.button.description: HI-3592: a button on a free slot's row (Version Control → Worktrees, Slots and copies): the slot still follows an older branch, and this moves it to the project's Work merges into, {to} (a branch name, such as 1.8.0). Asks first.

slots.move.buttonTip.defaultMessage: {slot} is free and still follows {from}: move it to {to}, the branch work merges into now
slots.move.buttonTip.description: HI-3592: the tooltip of a free slot's Move to… button. {slot} is its name (slot-e), {from} the older branch it follows, {to} the project's Work merges into.

slots.move.cant.description: HI-3592: a notification's title: the free slot ({slot}) can't move to Work merges into ({to}); its text says why.

slots.move.confirm.description: HI-3592: the button that moves the free slot to Work merges into.

slots.move.detail.defaultMessage: Checked again as it moves: if it was lent or changed meanwhile, it stays where it is.
slots.move.detail.description: HI-3592: under the question before moving a free slot to Work merges into.

slots.move.failed.description: HI-3592: an error's title: moving a free slot to Work merges into failed.

slots.move.kept.description: HI-3592: a notification's title: the slot ({slot}) was checked again as it moved and stayed on its branch ({from}); its text says why.

slots.move.message.defaultMessage: {slot} is free and still follows {from}. Its folder is detached at {to}, and its next card or lane starts there. Nothing in it is lost: it has no changes, and every commit it holds is in {from}.
slots.move.message.description: HI-3592: the question before moving a free slot ({slot}) from the older branch it follows ({from}) to Work merges into ({to}): what happens. Detached: git's word (its folder at that branch's commit, on no branch).

slots.move.moved.description: HI-3592: a notification after a free slot ({slot}) moved to Work merges into ({to}).

slots.move.onTarget.description: HI-3592: why a slot ({slot}) needs no move: it follows Work merges into ({to}) already.

slots.move.readFailed.defaultMessage: Could not check the slot's move
slots.move.readFailed.description: HI-3592: an error's title: Combwork couldn't check whether a slot can move to Work merges into.

slots.move.title.description: HI-3592: the question before moving a free slot ({slot}, such as slot-e) to the project's Work merges into ({to}, a branch name).

slots.release.changed.defaultMessage: {slot} changed meanwhile: its writer is no longer the one shown. Look again.
slots.release.changed.description: Release Slot… refused: the slot ({slot}, such as slot-b) was released or taken by another run while the question was open.

slots.release.live.defaultMessage: {slot}'s writer is still running in this Combwork: stop the agent, or end or keep what it left running, first.
slots.release.live.description: Release Slot… refused: the session writing in the slot ({slot}) still runs in this Combwork, or Combwork still follows the processes it left running (End or Keep Running in the agent's ⋯ menu settles them).

slots.release.notEnded.defaultMessage: Some of the processes listed still run: Windows didn't let Combwork end them, so {slot} wasn't released. Try again, or release it without ending them.
slots.release.notEnded.description: Release Slot… with "End these processes first": ending the listed processes failed (Windows refused), so the slot ({slot}) was left as it was.

slots.release.otherCombwork.defaultMessage: {slot} is held by another Combwork that is still running (process {pid}): release it there, or quit that Combwork first.
slots.release.otherCombwork.description: Release Slot… refused: another running copy of Combwork (its process id {pid}) holds the slot ({slot}).

slots.setting.bad.defaultMessage: That isn’t a slot setting Combwork has.
slots.setting.bad.description: An error: a request to change a setting of “Slots and copies” named one that doesn’t exist.

slots.setting.badSize.defaultMessage: The number of review and check copies is a whole number from {min, number} to {max, number}.
slots.setting.badSize.description: An error: the number of review and check copies given isn’t a whole number from 1 to 32. {min} and {max} are the limits (1 and 32).

slots.setting.badSwitch.defaultMessage: Set up submodules and LFS is on or off.
slots.setting.badSwitch.description: An error (HI-1182): a request to change the setting “Set up submodules and LFS” gave something other than on or off. Keep the setting’s name as Combwork shows it.

slots.setting.badText.defaultMessage: A slot script or list of files is text of at most {max, number} characters.
slots.setting.badText.description: An error: a slot script or list of copied files given isn’t text, or is too long. {max} is the limit (4,000).
